scope: Native eel body only. Excludes eel-warning-strip/eel-lightning-symbol/eel-discharge and all other marked2D effects.

shapeVolume.success: Recognizable elongated blue/yellow eel with a continuous tapered body, rounded friendly snout, integrated expressive eyes and a readable navy mouth. Fins and curled tail have visible dimensional thickness and soft edge transitions; whole actor reads as one coherent sculpted creature from every required facing.
shapeVolume.freedom: Useful native anatomy/proportion/topology/count changes are welcome. Do not demand the source cap,10-sided cross-section,29 rings,7 bones,12 meshes,thin stripe or original amplitudes. Retarget every required action if rig structure changes.
shapeVolume.avoid: A stretched flat cone, vertical cut-off head, glued-on eye balls, disconnected fins, broad fish paddle/species drift, added body effect symbols, or geometry built to copy only the frontal target.

color.success: Keep the blue body, warmer yellow dorsal/tail/side fins, white/navy eyes and dark mouth clearly separated at logical and phone scales. Blue crown/mid/lower surfaces have a controlled depth progression and compatible warmth.
color.avoid: Changing the eel to the GLOBAL plant palette, near-black lower body, muddy cream underside, neon clipping or extra unrelated accent clutter.

lightingHighlights.success: Soft native light reveals rounded volumes with broad controlled highlights, gentle transitions and readable undersides. Every facing looks comparably intentional.
lightingHighlights.hard: No preferred horizontal light direction and no directional ground shadow. Camera/frame/root and projected scale are fixed. Existing symmetric140/100W rig values are baseline observations, not required new treatment.
lightingHighlights.avoid: Blown white bands, black patches, noisy specular sparkle, harsh rim outlines, camera-facing target cards or per-view lighting/color fixes.

materialDetail.success: Clean softly finished cartoon surface, purposeful native fin shaping and facial articulation. Large form and color hierarchy dominate; fine detail earns its place by surviving real use size.
materialDetail.avoid: Arbitrary bevel/facet counts as a quality target, excessive tiny grooves, coplanar overlays, open seams, texture/normal popping, alpha fringe or copying target artifacts.

readability.success: At complete logical448x512 registration and uniform0.4 phone presentation, head/eyes, long tapered body and yellow fins/tail remain separable on light/gray/dark. All N/E/S/W maintain visible volume and deliberate facial orientation; do not invent unseen target views.
readability.method: Use unchanged current spriteFrame/worldRasterPlan/paintWorldRaster helpers with exact original root/frame/sourceScale/rects and painter order, both Chromium launch modes.

motion.success: Native continuous flexible body deformation visibly evaluates, with fins/eyes/mouth attached throughout. Preserve11 clip names,12 exported phases,12fps,original order,8 loops plus3 one-shots and held final phase. Loops close without pops; reaction clips remain brief world-actor motions.
motion.semantics: normal calm wave; swim stronger traveling wave; aim forward pitch; restless faster agitation/body roll; pursuit urgent higher-frequency wave; weave lateral whole-body turn; dash brisk beat with restrained yaw; pause restrained pitch/bob; hook brief struggle/roll; caught larger bent struggle; escape brief lifted turn. These are established by actual original keys/builder and diagnostic; source numeric magnitudes are not hard locks.
motion.repair: Repair the actual quaternion/Euler-key mismatch natively under existing structure-change authorization; do not preserve the broken rest-spine result as desired behavior. ROOT reconciliation pending.

artifactFree.success: No clipping, isolated dark patches, halos, unintended shadows, open caps/seams, eye/fin detachment, tearing, lost fins, self-intersection or frame/root jumps across required views/phases.
artifactFree.verification: Actual candidate pixels plus evaluated saved-source action/rig/camera/envelope evidence; hashes alone cannot approve.

approvalRule: No numeric score threshold. Missing visual/native evidence means needs_evidence. Candidate-specific approval only after ROOT freezes contract and independent judge inspects all declared packet candidateRenders/previews and unchanged acceptance checks pass.
